mutations.name: an ask the checkout is already past exits 0 instead of being refused
mutations.find: return refuse(`${past}; deploy that commit instead with titan-factory service deploy --expect ${head}`);
kills: titan-factory service deploy refuses as superseded, building nothing, when a rollback left the checkout's main past the asked sha (TP-4279)
titan-factory service deploy after a deploy rolls back and the pause is cleared, an older asked sha is refused and the next asked sha deploys (TP-4083, TP-4279)

mutations.name: a rolled-back deploy withdraws the deploy alarms
mutations.find: if (why !== undefined) return rollBackRestart(deploy, go, backup, why);
mutations.replace: if (why !== undefined) return resolveAlarms(deploy.ports, deploy.io).then(() => rollBackRestart(deploy, go, backup, why));
kills: service deploy rollback pause leaves the deploy alarms open when the restarted build rolls back
